_schema.purpose: Manual status decisions for execution/dependency-status.csv. An override wins over every automatic rule. Re-run build-dependency-status.mjs after editing. Only the entries in "overrides" are applied; this "_schema" block is documentation.

entry_fields.key: Row-level selector: <manifest>#<kind>#<name>, for example play/package.json#devDependencies#typescript. Set either key or name, never both.
entry_fields.name: Family-level selector: the dependency name. Applies to every manifest that declares it.
entry_fields.manifest: Optional, only together with name: restricts the family override to one manifest path.
entry_fields.status: One of: updated, already_current, blocked_with_reason, replaced_with_contract_proof, internal_rebuilt, in_progress, pending.
entry_fields.evidence: Required. Path of the receipt, or the one-line reason. Copied to status_evidence.
entry_fields.updated_utc: Required. UTC time of the decision as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Copied to status_updated_utc.

_schema.precedence: key beats name+manifest, which beats name alone. The build fails when two entries of equal precedence select the same row, or when an entry selects no row.
